compiled_state.title: Identify and document validation candidate epic (≥1500 LOC, ≥3 stories, no circular dep)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (prerequisite): Before the validation sprint can run, the candidate epic must be selected and confirmed. This task provides that selection gate.

## Description
Select the candidate epic for the E2E validation sprint. The epic must satisfy all of the following:
- ≥1500 total LOC across its stories (estimated via git diff on merged story branches or ticket description scope)
- ≥3 stories
- Does NOT depend on epic f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d (no circular dependency — use `.claude/scripts/dso ticket deps <candidate-id>` to verify)
- Is itself unblocked and ready for sprint (all prerequisites satisfied)
- Stories are available and not already in-progress under another worktree

Procedure:
1. Run `.claude/scripts/dso ticket list-epics --all` to enumerate open epics
2. For each candidate, run `.claude/scripts/dso ticket list-descendants <id>` and count stories
3. Verify no dependency path leads back to f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d
4. Estimate LOC from story descriptions or prior sprint stats if available
5. Select the best candidate; document the decision as a ticket comment on ea41-a8d8-ea1d-426f:
   - Candidate epic ID and title
   - Story count and estimated LOC
   - Dependency check result (no circular dep confirmed)
   - Why this epic was chosen over alternatives
6. Record the selected VALIDATION_EPIC_ID in the comment body with the literal prefix `VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:` so downstream tasks can extract it.

## File Impact
- `.claude/scripts/dso ticket` (read-only usage — no modification)

## Exemption Justification (Unit Test Exemption Criteria)
1. No conditional logic — purely a selection and documentation step; no branching code produced.
2. Any test would be a change-detector — only asserting a comment was written, not behavioral output.
3. Infrastructure-boundary-only — ticket CLI read operations + comment write; no business logic.
All three criteria apply; no RED test task dependency required.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/scripts/dso validate.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh 2>&1 | grep -v SKIP | tail -5
- [ ] Ticket comment on ea41-a8d8-ea1d-426f contains `VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:` with a non-empty epic ID
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && $REPO/.claude/scripts/dso ticket show ea41-a8d8-ea1d-426f | python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(c['body']) for c in t.get('comments',[]) if 'VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:' in c['body']]" | grep -q 'VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:'
- [ ] Candidate epic has ≥3 stories confirmed in the comment
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && $REPO/.claude/scripts/dso ticket show ea41-a8d8-ea1d-426f | python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(sys.stdin); comment=[c['body'] for c in t.get('comments',[]) if 'VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:' in c['body']]; print(comment[-1] if comment else '')" | grep -qiE 'stor(y|ies)|count'
- [ ] No circular dependency to f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d confirmed in the comment
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && $REPO/.claude/scripts/dso ticket show ea41-a8d8-ea1d-426f | python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(sys.stdin); comment=[c['body'] for c in t.get('comments',[]) if 'VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:' in c['body']]; print(comment[-1] if comment else '')" | grep -qi 'circular\|no dep\|dependency check'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
